name: Yamanaka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yamanaka town emblem in maroon: a ring divided by a vertical bar with a pointed top, like the character 中.
history: Flag of the former town of Yamanaka in Ishikawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01.

features.role: Yamanaka town emblem — a ring divided by a vertical bar with a pointed top, like the character 中
